label: Приехать
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for приехать (to arrive, to come by vehicle).

missions.phrase: Я приеду к вам завтра утром.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person perfective future. 'Приеду' is the 1sg future of perfective приехать, built with prefix при- on the future stem приед-. Like all motion-by-vehicle verbs, it implies arriving by transport.

missions.phrase: Ты приедешь на машине или поездом?
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Second-person future. 'Приедешь' is the 2sg future of приехать. The verb specifically covers arrival by some vehicle, contrasted with прийти for arriving on foot.

missions.phrase: Он приедет в город через неделю.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Third-person future. 'Приедет' is the 3sg future of приехать. 'В город' uses в + accusative for the destination. The prefix при- marks a complete arrival.
Strategic focus: First-person plural future. 'Приедем' is the 1pl future of приехать. 'К ужину' uses к + dative to set arrival timed for dinner.

missions.phrase: Вы приедете на конференцию в среду?
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Polite/plural future. 'Приедете' is the 2pl future of приехать. 'На конференцию' uses на + accusative for the event. Note the future stem приед- across persons.

missions.phrase: Родители приедут в гости на выходных.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Third-person plural future. 'Приедут' is the 3pl future, completing the future scaffold of приехать. The whole present-future series runs on the stem приед-.
Strategic focus: Masculine past. 'Приехал' is the masculine past of приехать, formed regularly on the past stem приеха-. It reports a single completed arrival by vehicle.

missions.phrase: Она приехала из Москвы на поезде.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Feminine past. 'Приехала' uses the приеха- past stem, marking a female subject. 'Из Москвы' uses из + genitive for the point of origin.

missions.phrase: Гости приехали раньше, чем мы ждали.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Plural past. 'Приехали' is the plural past of приехать on the приеха- stem. Past tense agrees in number and gender, not person.

missions.phrase: Приезжай к нам летом на дачу!
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Defective imperative. Приехать has no command of its own, so the imperative is borrowed from the imperfective приезжать, giving 'приезжай'. It also serves as a warm, repeatable invitation.
